name: Haysville (United States)
description: Blue upper part and red lower part divided by a white curve, charged with the city's white Flying H logo and a yellow star.
history: Haysville is a city in Sedgwick County, Kansas, and a southern suburb of Wichita. The flag was adopted on 21 October 2017 (the winning entry of a community contest by Dana DeCicco, unveiled on 21 October 2017, according to Flags of the World citing KWCH and the Derby Informer).

features.role: Flying H logo, its two stems recalling the tornadoes of the 1990s
